amenitiesDescription:
The St. Regis Residences Miami delivers over 50,000 SF of interior and exterior amenity space anchored by a bayside infinity pool with private cabanas, poolside bar and café, and a proposed private marina on city-owned submerged land, cleared by the City Commission so developers may begin submitting permits (city lease and slip count still pending). The Holistic Wellness Center features an indoor 25-meter lap pool, cold plunge, Pilates and yoga studio, salt spa room, dual saunas, steam rooms, and state-of-the-art treatment rooms, with curated programming by The Wright Fit.

The 31st-floor Sky Lounge houses the signature St. Regis Cognac Room, St. Regis Tea Room, and a double-height bar and lounge with sweeping bay views. Additional amenities include a ground-floor fine dining restaurant by Michelin-starred chef Fabio Trabocchi, exclusive beach club access, salon, pet spa, media room, business center, golf simulator, children's entertainment room, and guest suites.

Services include 24-hour concierge, St. Regis Butler Service, housekeeping, in-residence dining, valet, luxury house car, and global St. Regis membership privileges. The tower features secure, on-site, 24-hour valet parking, private residential parking, and dedicated EV charging stations.
architectQuote: We drew on the great ocean liners of the golden age: their sense of arrival, their craftsmanship, their timeless elegance.
description: Residence-only, no hotel component. Robert A.M. Stern Architects with Rockwell Group interiors. 152 private bayfront homes in South Brickell, with the St. Regis Butler program and Wright Fit wellness programming. Q4 2027 delivery.

investmentThesis: The first St. Regis residence in Miami, and one of the few new South Brickell projects offered as a residence-only program with no hotel component, protecting service consistency for owners. A proposed private marina on city-owned submerged land would add scarce yacht dockage to an already gated bayfront site. The Wright Fit curates wellness programming. South Brickell's bayfront corridor has limited remaining development sites and no comparable residence-only competition at this service tier.
name: St. Regis Brickell Residences
parking: Secure, on-site, 24-hour valet parking, private residential parking, and dedicated EV charging stations
residenceContent: A gated bayfront enclave of 152 private homes in South Brickell, with no hotel rooms and no transient use. Every residence features 11-foot ceilings, private elevator with direct entry foyer, double-door arrival, custom European stone flooring, and expansive flow-through terraces oriented to capture both Biscayne Bay and Coconut Grove sightlines. Kitchens include Gaggenau appliance suites, honed natural stone countertops, and custom millwork. Primary bathrooms feature radiant heated floors, free-standing soaking tubs, and his-and-hers vanities. Robert A.M. Stern's design language is modern classicism (proportion and permanence), with Rockwell Group's interiors layering texture, warmth, and craft. Minutes from Coconut Grove, Downtown Miami, and Key Biscayne.
